job.qualifications: Python, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, distributed systems

resume_template:
{name}
Backend engineer with 4 years building Python services. Shipped a payments API on FastAPI and PostgreSQL; on-call for a 3-service platform.
transcript_template:
Interviewer: Thanks for joining, {name}. Tell me a little about yourself.
Candidate: Sure. I'm a backend engineer with about four years of experience, mostly in Python. Most recently I built and owned a payments API using FastAPI and PostgreSQL, and I was on call for a small platform of three services.
Interviewer: How did you keep that payments API reliable under load?
Candidate: We added idempotency keys so retries wouldn't double-charge, put the write path behind a queue, and set up alerting on p99 latency and error rate. We also load-tested before big launches.
Interviewer: Great. Any questions for me?
Candidate: Yes, what does the on-call rotation and incident process look like on this team?
